page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, one column of text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Below the last line: catchword at right and gathering signature at centre-left.

main_text.l: omnia hæc non honorata solùm[?],sed lauta
quoque munera sunt, & opima. De cæte-
ris, quæ collegio Doccumano cohærent,
ut Scribæ & Fisci præfecti,quæ provinciæ
huic cum Translavicanis sunt commu-
nia, & quæ his similia alia, dicere non li-
bet, ne prolixior fiam. Et hæc quidem fo-
ris : reliqua domi. Horum primum&præ-
cipuum Provinciale collegium, ut initio
institutum fuit, collegas octo habuit, de-
inde post sexennium sex habere cœpit,
& adhuc habet, pari numero hinc inde
lectos : de quorum munere amplissimo
ante nobis dictum. Oppidanos senatus e-
dit, & ferè ex his, qui in consulatu aut
senatu fuêre, eosque pro arbitrio suo aut
mutat anno exacto, aut in munere ma-
nere patitur. Nec alius agrariorum mos,
qui reliquos designant. Collegæ, ut an-
tè ostendi, per vices, atque in orbem
præsident, alternatimque oppidanus &
agrarius:vices septimana finiuntur. Qu-
æstor autem collegii, cui amplissima pe-
cunia tractanda committitur, item Scri-
ba à secretis, conjunctim ab oppidanis
& agrariis eliguntur in conventu com-
muni,

marginalia.note: Collegium Deputato-rum, uti vocât,quod nunc ad VIVIROS redactum.

page.notes: Right margin note: "Collegium Deputato-rum, uti vocât, quod nunc ad VIVIROS redactum." set in small italic, printed as one note over several lines. The first word of the first line ("solùm") is doubtful; the initial letter reads as an "s" or "i" and is marked [?]. The running head is printed as "Deque Vrbe Groninga" and is given here with u/v normalised. The catchword "muni," is printed at the right below the last line. Faint digitiser text at the lower right corner is not transcribed.
